title: Celestial Dream Bridge
description: A wooden pier with wind chimes curves through a cosmic night sky, populated by silhouetted figures with ornate headdresses, a green alien holding a smaller blue one, a white-headed alien with raised hands, and three cats sitting along the railing. Above them floats a giant cracked moon with a serene sleeping face inside a glowing purple ornate circular frame, while dollar bills and objects fall into the stylized blue waves below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a curved wooden pier with purple railings and hanging wind chimes extending over stylized turquoise ocean waves with falling dollar bills. Silhouetted Black figures with intricate beaded headdresses stand on the bridge, joined by a small green alien holding a tiny blue figure, a tall green alien with a white rounded head and raised hands, and three cats in black, grey, and orange sitting on the railing. In the starry sky above, a massive cracked moon with a peaceful sleeping feminine face is framed by an ornate glowing purple circular mandala. Ethereal smoke and floating orange lights fill the dark cosmic background.
